description: Tauri menu-bar / tray-anchored popover panel app (Raycast-like floating panel).

defaults.headline: Starter Foundry Menu Bar
defaults.subheadline: A tray-anchored popover panel for quick actions, search, and commands.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick tauri-menubar when the app lives in the macOS menu bar or Windows system tray and opens a small floating popover on click (Raycast, Bartender, 1Password mini). The primary window is a short-lived panel positioned near the tray icon — NOT a long-lived workspace window. If the user wants a full desktop window, use tauri-desktop instead. If they want a tray icon with ONLY a menu (no popover), use tauri-tray.
architectureNotes: src-tauri/src/lib.rs owns the TrayIconBuilder and positions the window under the tray icon on show; main.rs just forwards to lib::run().
The popover window is decorations:false, alwaysOnTop:true, skipTaskbar:true, resizable:false at 320x400.
Hide-on-blur is wired via the on_window_event focus handler so the panel dismisses like a native menu.
On macOS set activation policy to Accessory so no dock icon appears; on Windows skipTaskbar achieves the same effect.
Global shortcut (cmd+shift+space default) toggles the popover — register through tauri-plugin-global-shortcut.
components: TrayIcon handler (Rust) — opens/positions the popover relative to the click location.
Compact popover shell (React) — fixed 320x400, scrollable list, single-column layout.
Command input / fuzzy search row as the primary interaction pattern.
gotchas: macOS: set `LSUIElement` (activation policy Accessory) or the app shows a dock icon AND the menu-bar icon. Use tauri::ActivationPolicy::Accessory on macOS at setup time.
macOS notarization: menu-bar apps still need notarization for Gatekeeper — ship with `tauri-build` signing and run `xcrun notarytool submit` before distribution.
Windows: tray icons need a real .ico file; Tauri default sizing is 16x16 — ship multi-resolution icons or they render blurry on HiDPI.

Positioning: macOS menu-bar Y coordinate is measured from the top, but some multi-monitor setups put the menu bar on a non-primary display — read `monitor.position()` from the tray event, don't hardcode.
Hide-on-blur on Windows fires focus-lost when the user clicks the tray icon itself, causing a show-then-immediately-hide loop; gate the hide with a 100ms debounce.
Auto-launch at login uses tauri-plugin-autostart — on macOS this creates a LaunchAgent plist, on Windows a registry Run key. Users must grant the permission explicitly.
integrations: tauri-plugin-global-shortcut — hotkey to toggle the popover
tauri-plugin-positioner — canonical popover positioning relative to tray
